Winter.feel: Cold air and indoor heating pull water out of skin.
Winter.lean: Creams, balms, glycerin, ceramides, shea, squalane, oils at night.
Winter.ease: Foaming cleansers, strong acids, alcohol toners.
Winter.make: Lip balm, body butter, face oil

Spring.feel: Pollen and swinging temperatures can make skin reactive.
Spring.lean: Lotions, calming centella, oat, niacinamide; restart SPF habits.
Spring.ease: New strong actives all at once during allergy flares.
Spring.make: Oat mask, chamomile toner (preserved), light face oil

Summer.feel: Heat, sweat and UV: more oil, more sun damage.
Summer.lean: Gels, water-resistant SPF 50, antioxidants, gentle double cleanse.
Summer.ease: Heavy oils by day, citrus oils on skin, retinoids without strict SPF.
Summer.make: Aloe mist (fridge), clay mask, light body oil

Autumn.feel: Air turns dry; summer sun damage shows.
Autumn.lean: Back to richer layers, retinoids or azelaic for spots, hydrating toners.
Autumn.make: Rich cream, body oil, honey mask
